body:
Look good to me.

I did a cursory review of the plugin too and tried to test it, but I wasn't able to. I keep running into errors related to files not loading.

I also couldn't test it with 4.6 because the manually placed OBB file gets deleted on app start. Additionally, I don't have any apps on the Play Store that use OBB, so I can't validate it that way either.

As I mentioned in the last meeting, I strongly believe that we should consider removing OBB support altogether. The Play Store deprecated it in 2021, and Godot 4 was released in 2023. It's unlikely we'd be breaking compatibility, anyone still relying on OBB is probably using Godot 3.

That said, since you've already created a plugin for it, if someone does report that they're using OBB, we can ask them to help test and validate the plugin.

I agree with the rationale to remove this.

Small pedantic terminology note, AFAIUI, "deprecate" means "put a note that something will be removed, but don't remove it". This PR doesn't deprecate the feature in Godot, it removes it outright without warning. It is however deprecated _by Google Play_ so we're removing a Google-deprecated feature.
